sources.note: Main vendor website. Describes OP as 'The Best Pediatric-Specialty EHR' and 'Dual-Certified EHR for Pediatric Practices'. Site is JavaScript-heavy; limited content extractable via scraping.
ONC certification info / mandatory disclosures page. Content not extractable due to JS rendering.

EMRSystems profile. Describes integrated EHR, PM, and RCM. Lists pediatric templates, growth charts, VacLogic immunization forecasting, school/camp forms, patient portal, scheduling, billing. Notes Surescripts White Coat of Quality Award (2011, 2013). Pricing ~$118 USD.
2023 review. Describes pediatric-specific templates, immunization management, clinical decision support, patient portal, billing/revenue cycle. Notes integration challenges with third-party systems.

FindEMR profile. Lists 29 user reviews. Cloud-based, serves pediatric practices. Features include pediatric templates, scheduling, patient portal, RCM, reporting, lab integration, telemedicine, insurance eligibility verification. Users: pediatricians, nurses, clinical staff, admin workers, IT, billers.

Feb 2022 press release. Announces 'Whole Child' platform via acquisitions of NextStep Solutions (behavioral health EHR) and RemedyConnect (telehealth, after-hours answering, website/marketing). CEO Kraig Brown quoted. Dr. Dan Feiten joined as Medical Director.
Sep 2014 press release. OP acquires assets of Workflow.com (web-based multi-specialty EHR/PM). Combined company had 175+ employees, 3,000+ providers, 750 practices.

EHR in Practice profile. Describes OP as integrated EHR and PM suite by Connexin Software. Created 1992 by Visual Data, merged with AFS in 2007. Desktop and browser-based (Windows/Mac). Features: scheduling, clinical docs, exam room, billing, growth charts (including Down's/preemie), 175+ school/camp forms, vaccine forecasting, developmental assessments.
OP Difference page. Content not extractable due to JS rendering.
Discover OP page. Content not extractable due to JS rendering.
ePrescribing/EPCS page. OP offers EPCS with DEA-compliant security for prescribing controlled substances electronically.
Behavioral health tools page. Content not extractable due to JS rendering, but search snippets describe Mental Health Monitor for PHQ-9, GAD-7 dashboards.
Practice management page. Search snippets describe well-visit recalls per AAP schedule, provider productivity tracking, insurance validation, patient flow by room/calendar.
In-house billing & clearinghouses page. Content not fully extractable, but describes billing and clearinghouse integration.
Practice analytics and pediatric benchmarking page (from search results).
BridgeInteract blog about OP's new patient portal launch. Portal powered by BridgeInteract, announced Sep 2024.
Sep 2024 press release. New Patient Portal with bilingual support (English/Spanish), message routing to designated staff, self-scheduling.
Remedy Telehealth page. HIPAA-compliant virtual care platform with video conferencing and speech dictation.

Interoperability & connectivity page. Search snippets describe document scanning into patient charts, bi-directional eFax, eLabs connections to hundreds of labs, in-house device connectivity, digitized referral workflows.
KLAS Research user comments page. 97% retention rate. Users note ease of use, pediatric-focused design, but some integration and support challenges.
CB Insights profile for Connexin Software (Office Practicum's parent company). Confirms company identity.
